title: El Mango de El Rosario, VISTA STORIES
comment: mango-rosario (VISTA): rancho de mangos en El Rosario, Sinaloa. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.XIMENA_LIZARRAGA: Mexican woman from Sinaloa, 22 years old, tanned light-brown skin, long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, a faded green cotton t-shirt, a canvas apron, denim shorts over leggings, work boots, her hands empty.
chars.ARTURO_LIZARRAGA: Mexican rancher from Sinaloa, 54 years old, tall, tanned light skin, short black-and-grey hair, a black goatee, a straw cowboy hat, a light-blue denim shirt with rolled sleeves, jeans, a brown leather belt, boots, his hands empty.
chars.BRENDA_OSUNA: Mexican woman, 40 years old, light skin, long platinum-blonde hair with waves, big sunglasses on her head, red lipstick, a white linen sundress, gold bracelets, white sandals, holding a glass of iced drink.

locs.LOC_RANCHOMANGO: Mango ranch in El Rosario, Sinaloa, in the hot late afternoon: a packing area under a tin roof with stacks of wooden crates full of ripe red-and-yellow mangos, a long sorting table, rows of big mango trees, a white ranch house with a shaded veranda and a lounge chair, a fresh tree stump near the house, golden light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
